name: job-progress
description: Live job progress over the selected jobs and events providers, streamed to clients with SSE.
instructions: Configure the selected jobs and events providers before starting the API.
Start a job:     curl -XPOST localhost:5002/progress -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"steps":5}'
The stream shows job-progress events 20 -> 40 -> ... -> 100 through the selected events provider.
